title: Roblox takes L1, R1, R3 and Select from a controller before a script sees them
observation: Logging UserInputService.InputBegan in a game that gives players a Tool showed ButtonL1 and ButtonR1 arriving already processed (the hotbar's RBXHotbarEquip), ButtonR3 processed (the camera's RbxCameraGamepadZoom) and ButtonSelect processed (GUI navigation while GuiService.AutoSelectGuiEnabled is on). A handler that returned on processed input never ran for them: a boat trick bound to R1 had never worked on a controller. A ContextActionService binding above Roblox's priority received L1, R1 and R3 (Select still only showed its release), and the actions then worked while the sword stayed in hand.
recommendation: Bind gamepad shoulder buttons and stick clicks with ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority above the default priority, leave Select to Roblox, and test each binding by sending its key code and logging whether InputBegan reports it as processed.
applies_when: The game gives players a Tool (the hotbar is active)
limits: Key codes were sent through Studio MCP as keyboard input, not from a real controller
Observed with Roblox's default PlayerModule and backpack in October 2026

evidence.detail: Section C, H9: the processed-input log and the behaviour after the ContextActionService binding.
